site.name: Open Creative Suite
site.description: PixelDotNet, VectorDotNet, Hieroglyph.NET and Sonus.NET: professional image editing, vector design, typeface design and voice shaping tools. Free forever, source-available, with no subscriptions and no accounts.

products.name: PixelDotNet
products.tagline: An editor that gets out of the way.
products.blurb: A desktop image editor for the jobs people actually do: retouching a photo, cutting out a subject, building a poster, or painting something from scratch.

hero.alt: PixelDotNet editing the Moonlight sample artwork, with the tool rail, canvas and layer stack visible

shots.alt: PixelDotNet painting a white brush stroke on its own layer over the Moonlight sample
shots.label: Painting
shots.caption: Brushes, shapes and gradients on their own layers, with live options for every tool.

shots.alt: PixelDotNet Quick Selection growing around the moon and sky in the Moonlight sample
shots.label: Cut-outs
shots.caption: Quick Selection grows around the subject while the original pixels stay underneath.

shots.alt: PixelDotNet Text effects panel with outline and glow controls on a Moonlight text layer
shots.label: Text effects
shots.caption: Live outlines, shadows and glows, still editable when you reopen the layer.

features.title: Paint and draw
features.body: A round brush with size, hardness and opacity, plus eraser, lines, rectangles, ellipses, gradients, paths and live text.

features.title: Retouch the mess
features.body: Clone Stamp, Healing Brush, Dodge and Burn, Content-Aware Fill, perspective and mesh warp: the everyday repair kit.

features.title: Cut it out clean
features.body: Quick Selection, Magic Wand and layer masks. Lift a subject off its background and keep the edges honest.

features.title: Layers that behave
features.body: Masks, clipping, groups, blend modes and smart objects. Non-destructive shadows, strokes and glows.

features.title: Type with teeth
features.body: Editable text layers with outlines, shadows and glows, plus text on a path when the layout asks for it.

features.title: Real files, no lock-in
features.body: PNG, JPEG, BMP, TGA, SVG and layered .pxd projects. Batch-resize and convert a folder when the brief changes.

shots.label: Painting
shots.caption: Brushes, shapes and gradients on their own layers, with live options for every tool.

shots.label: Cut-outs
shots.caption: Quick Selection grows around the subject while the original pixels stay underneath.

shots.label: Text effects
shots.caption: Live outlines, shadows and glows, still editable when you reopen the layer.

detailSections.title:
Paint, shape,
and path.
detailSections.lede: A brush that behaves, shape layers you can reopen, and paths whose nodes stay editable. The drawing tools are built to be adjusted later, not baked in.

features.title: Brush with options
features.body: A round brush with size, hardness and opacity, plus eraser, line, rectangle, ellipse, gradient, bucket and eyedropper in the same rail.

features.title: Shape layers
features.body: Turn on Shape layer for a rectangle, ellipse or line, then reopen Edit Shape to change its size, stroke, fill and colour.

features.title: Paths and nodes
features.body: Draw with the Pen, then drag anchors and handles, click a segment to insert a node, and add or delete points precisely.

features.title: Retouch kit
features.body: Clone Stamp, Healing Brush, Dodge and Burn, Content-Aware Fill, perspective and mesh warp for the everyday repairs.

images.label: Paint
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Brush tool painting a stroke on its own layer
images.caption: The Brush is active, the stroke lands on its own layer, and size, hardness and opacity are one drag away.

images.label: Shapes
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Edit Shape dialog with position, size, stroke, fill and colour controls
images.caption: Edit Shape. A shape layer keeps its position, size, outline and fill editable long after it was drawn.

images.label: Paths
images.alt: A PixelDotNet path layer with visible anchors and one selected node
images.caption: Edit nodes. Drag an anchor to move the path or a handle to change the curve, with Add Node and Delete Node for precision.

detailSections.title:
Cut out.
Keep the pixels.
detailSections.lede: Selections protect part of the picture while you work. Masks make that protection permanent, paintable and completely reversible.

features.title: Quick Selection
features.body: Paint over a subject and the selection grows through neighbouring similar pixels. Hold Alt or press Subtract to take areas back.

features.title: Five selection tools
features.body: Marquee, ellipse, lasso, Magic Wand and Quick Selection, with Shift, Ctrl and Alt to add, subtract or intersect areas.

features.title: Layer masks
features.body: White reveals, black hides and grey fades. Paint the mask at any time; the layer pixels are never destroyed.

features.title: Clip and align
features.body: Clip a layer to the artwork below, or use rulers, guides and snapping to line everything up.

images.label: Cut-outs
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Quick Selection tool highlighting the sky and moon on the sample image
images.caption: Quick Selection grows through connected, similar pixels. Alt or Subtract takes back the background it caught.

images.label: Selections
images.alt: A rectangular marquee selection shown as a dotted outline on the PixelDotNet canvas
images.caption: A marquee selection. Everything outside the dashed outline is protected from the next edit.

detailSections.title:
A stack you
can undo.
detailSections.lede: Every element gets its own layer, and every layer keeps its options. Groups, blend modes, live styles and smart objects are all part of the file.

features.title: Groups and blending
features.body: Fold related layers into groups, fade a whole group at once, and mix with Multiply, Screen, Overlay and the rest.

features.title: Layer styles
features.body: Drop shadow, stroke and outer glow redraw automatically whenever the layer or its mask changes.

features.title: Smart objects
features.body: Scale, rotate and flip from a pristine copy of the original pixels, so repeated transforms stay sharp.

features.title: Locks and visibility
features.body: Lock a finished layer, hide it with the eye, clip it to the layer below, or mask it without touching the pixels.

images.label: Layers
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Layers panel with a group, layers, blend mode, clip, opacity and layer actions
images.caption: The Layers panel. Groups, blend mode, clip and opacity all apply to the active row.

images.label: Styles
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Layer Style dialog showing Drop Shadow, Stroke and Outer Glow controls
images.caption: Layer Style. Non-destructive shadows, strokes and glows that follow the artwork.

images.label: Smart objects
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Smart Object transform dialog with position, scale, rotation and flip controls
images.caption: Smart Object. Repeated transforms recalculate from the source pixels instead of resampling.

detailSections.title:
Words that
stay words.
detailSections.lede: Text layers remain editable, effects stay live, and type can follow any path you draw. Change the words or the curve whenever you like.

features.title: Editable text
features.body: Place a text layer, then reopen Edit Text to change the content, font, size, rotation, spacing, weight and fill.

features.title: Live effects
features.body: Outlines, shadows and glows with presets and fine sliders. They stay attached to the text, not baked into it.

features.title: Text on a path
features.body: Attach text to a path, slide it with Path offset and adjust spacing. Edit the nodes later and the letters follow.

features.title: Fonts on demand
features.body: Work with installed families, or paste a font URL into the picker. It is the only optional online action in the app.

images.label: Text
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Edit Text dialog with text content, font, size, rotation and fill controls
images.caption: Edit Text. The layer stays editable until you choose to rasterize it.

images.label: Text FX
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Text effects panel with outline, shadow and glow presets
images.caption: Text effects. Presets set the look; the sliders refine the outline, shadow and glow.

images.label: On a path
images.alt: Text following a curved path layer in PixelDotNet
images.caption: Text on a path. The letters rotate with the curve and update when the path changes.

detailSections.title:
Grade it.
Bend it.
detailSections.lede: Fix exposure and colour, apply a filter, then pull the picture into shape. Every control previews live and respects the current selection.

features.title: Adjust tab
features.body: Brightness, contrast, hue, saturation and lightness, plus Levels and Curves, all previewed from the original pixels.

features.title: Adjustment layers
features.body: Add a Levels or Curves layer to change everything below it without altering a single pixel.

features.title: Effects
features.body: Gaussian and motion blur, fragment, pixelate, sharpen, emboss, edge detect, noise, posterize and vignette.

features.title: Colour Tools
features.body: Colour balance, threshold, gradient map, replace colour, red-eye, channel mixer, selective colour and split channels.

images.label: Adjust
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Adjust tab with brightness, contrast, hue, saturation, levels and curves
images.caption: The Adjust tab. Live sliders, Levels and Curves, all limited to the selection when one exists.

images.label: Effects
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Effects tab with the effect list and amount slider
images.caption: The Effects tab. Pick a filter, set the amount, then Apply or Cancel.

images.label: Colour
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Colour Tools window with Colour Balance, Threshold and Gradient Map
images.caption: Colour Tools. Eight independent operations, each with its own Apply button.

detailSections.title:
Tilt, warp,
resize.
detailSections.lede: Perspective for straight edges, mesh warp for gentle reshaping, and document controls that change the artwork or just the frame.

features.title: Perspective Transform
features.body: Pull each corner independently to straighten a building, poster or screen. The preview updates live.

features.title: Mesh Warp
features.body: A three-by-three grid bends the layer or selection around nine draggable points.

features.title: Image and Canvas Size
features.body: Scale every layer, mask and guide, or add transparent space around the artwork without stretching it.

features.title: History
features.body: A 24-step undo timeline per document. Jump back and forward without losing the thread.

images.label: Perspective
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Perspective Transform dialog with eight corner offset sliders
images.caption: Perspective Transform. One pair of sliders for each corner, previewed live on the layer.

images.label: Mesh warp
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Mesh Warp grid with nine draggable points on the canvas
images.caption: Mesh Warp. Drag the nine points to bend the picture, then press Done.

images.label: Resize
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Image Size dialog with width, height and keep-aspect-ratio controls
images.caption: Image Size. Scale all layers, masks and guides in one undoable step.

detailSections.title:
Save it.
Ship it.
detailSections.lede: Share a flat image, keep a layered project, process a whole folder, or move vector artwork in and out without flattening it.

features.title: Layered projects
features.body: .pxd files keep every layer, mask, group, style, smart object, shape, path and text layer.

features.title: Everyday formats
features.body: PNG and TGA keep transparency, JPEG and BMP are ready to share, and the in-app browser remembers the folder.

features.title: Batch Process
features.body: Resize, rename with a suffix and convert every supported image in a folder without opening a single tab.

features.title: SVG in and out
features.body: Import SVG shapes as editable layers, and export shape, path and text layers as real SVG; painted layers ride along as an embedded PNG.

images.label: Save
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Save Image file browser with folders, file list, name field and format buttons
images.caption: Save Image. Pick a folder, type a name, choose PNG, JPEG, BMP or TGA.

images.label: Batch
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Batch Processing dialog with source and output folders, scale, suffix and format
images.caption: Batch Processing. Point at a source and an output folder, then Run.

images.label: SVG in
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Import SVG file browser showing an SVG file selected
images.caption: Import SVG. Each shape arrives as its own editable layer.

images.label: SVG out
images.alt: The PixelDotNet Export SVG file browser
images.caption: Export SVG. Shapes, paths and text stay vector; painted layers are embedded as a PNG.

products.name: VectorDotNet
products.blurb: A desktop vector studio for illustration, icons, logos and layout. Draw real Bézier paths, shape them, style them and export clean SVG.

hero.alt: VectorDotNet showing a poster artboard, live rounded rectangle selection and the inspector

shots.label: Canvas
shots.caption: Artboards, rulers, live shapes and a stable workspace that keeps up with the pointer.

shots.label: Colour
shots.caption: An HSV field, alpha strip, recent colours and a palette pulled from your document.

shots.label: Typography
shots.caption: Every installed family, previewed in its own face, plus your own font files at runtime.

features.title: Draw real curves
features.body: A pen with cubic anchors and mirrored handles, a smoothing pencil, lasso and full direct-selection editing.

features.title: Live shapes
features.body: Rectangles, ellipses, stars, polygons and spirals keep their parameters. Change a corner radius or add points later.

features.title: Snap to anything
features.body: Smart guides for object edges and centres, artboards, the grid and dragged ruler guides, with Shift to constrain.

features.title: Documents, organised
features.body: Nested groups, unlimited layers, locks, visibility, artboards, tabs and independent undo histories.

features.title: Colour and type
features.body: An HSV picker with alpha and document palettes; searchable system fonts with live previews and runtime font loading.

features.title: Clean SVG in and out
features.body: Import SVG and SVGZ into editable groups and paths. Export standards-compliant SVG or SVGZ, not a flattened picture.

shots.label: Workspace
shots.caption: The sample poster: artboards, a live selection, and every object still editable in the layer tree.

shots.label: Colour
shots.caption: Pick a colour with the field and strips, or pull one straight from the artwork.

shots.label: Typography
shots.caption: Search every installed family, preview it in its own face, or load a font file on the spot.

products.name: Hieroglyph.NET
products.tagline: Design a typeface. Export a real font.
products.blurb: A desktop typeface editor for anyone who wants to make a font: paint a character for every letter, preview the alphabet, then export a real TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 file you can install and use.

hero.alt: Hieroglyph.NET editing the letter A, with the character browser, metric guides, inspector and live type preview

shots.label: Drawing
shots.caption: Drag with the brush and the stroke becomes one smooth, closed, editable outline.

shots.label: Preview
shots.caption: A live preview dock renders the developing typeface with size, tracking and leading controls.

shots.label: Export
shots.caption: Four font formats, a plain-language validation report and one-click install.

features.title: A brush that draws
features.body: Drag freely and the stroke becomes one smooth, editable outline, with an adjustable width in font units. The pen is there when you want exact curves.

features.title: Guides that mean something
features.body: Baseline, x-height, cap height, ascender and descender on the canvas, with sidebearing shading and a draggable advance width.

features.title: Space the alphabet
features.body: Advance widths and sidebearings for every character, plus a visual kerning editor for AV, To, Ta and any pair you choose.

features.title: See it as text
features.body: Live text, the full alphabet and kerning previews while you edit, and a specimen sheet that presents the finished family.

features.title: Real font files
features.body: TrueType, CFF, kerning tables and web-font containers compiled from your outlines, with a report written for people rather than compilers.

features.title: Yours to keep
features.body: Projects are readable .hgl JSON files. Export TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2, install on Windows in one click, and own the typeface outright.

shots.label: Drawing
shots.caption: The em square, metric guides and live stroke preview. Every point stays editable after the brush commits it.

shots.label: Preview
shots.caption: Type a sample, switch to the alphabet or kerning tab, and see the typeface working before it is compiled.

shots.label: Export
shots.caption: Choose a format, read what is unfinished, then install the font or open the specimen sheet.

products.name: Sonus.NET
products.tagline: Shape the voice. Keep the words.
products.blurb: A local-first voice studio for Windows. Sonus listens to your microphone, shapes it through five visual stages, lets you hear the result in headphones, and sends it anywhere as a virtual microphone.

hero.alt: The Sonus.NET main window with the Voice stage open, the signal path on the left and live audio metering

shots.label: Tone
shots.alt: The Sonus.NET Tone stage with a draggable frequency-response curve and low and high cut
shots.caption: Drag Low, Body, Presence and Air points directly on the curve; the sound follows immediately.

shots.label: Voice
shots.alt: The Sonus.NET Voice stage with pitch, vocal size, resonance, brightness and texture controls
shots.caption: Pitch moves the note while vocal size moves the formants, so a voice can feel bigger or smaller.

shots.label: Space
shots.alt: The Sonus.NET Space stage showing a room decay curve and echo controls
shots.caption: A short room, a room mix and a controlled echo place the voice somewhere else.

shots.label: Recording
shots.alt: The Sonus.NET Takes panel with raw and processed versions of recent recordings
shots.caption: Every take keeps both versions: the raw microphone and the processed result.

shots.label: Presets
shots.alt: The Sonus.NET preset library with enhancement and character presets
shots.caption: Start from an enhancement or a character preset, then save your own as local JSON.

shots.label: Devices
shots.alt: The Sonus.NET audio settings with microphone, headphones and virtual microphone choices
shots.caption: Choose the physical microphone, the headphones and the virtual output in one place.

features.title: Live microphone capture
features.body: Pick a device, set the input trim and watch the meters. A clipping hold shows when the signal went hot, and capture stops cleanly if a device disappears.

features.title: Five visual stages
features.body: Clean, Tone, Dynamics, Voice and Space, each with its own editor and a bypass so you can hear exactly what it contributes.

features.title: A voice, not just an EQ
features.body: Pitch and vocal size move independently, then resonance, brightness and texture finish the character.

features.title: Hear yourself
features.body: Choose headphones, set a monitor level independent of the virtual output, and press TEST to confirm the route with a chime.

features.title: A real virtual microphone
features.body: Sonus drives the signed VB-CABLE device, so Discord, OBS, Teams and games can select it like any other microphone.

features.title: Raw and processed takes
features.body: Every recording writes the untouched microphone and the processed voice as two 48 kHz WAV files you can compare instantly.

shots.label: Tone
shots.caption: Drag Low, Body, Presence and Air points directly on the curve; the sound follows immediately.

shots.label: Voice
shots.caption: Pitch moves the note while vocal size moves the formants, so a voice can feel bigger or smaller.

shots.label: Space
shots.caption: A short room, a room mix and a controlled echo place the voice somewhere else.

shots.label: Recording
shots.caption: Every take keeps both versions: the raw microphone and the processed result.

shots.label: Presets
shots.caption: Start from an enhancement or a character preset, then save your own as local JSON.

shots.label: Devices
shots.caption: Choose the physical microphone, the headphones and the virtual output in one place.

detailSections.title:
One path.
Five stages.
detailSections.lede: Each stage does one job and can be bypassed, so you always know what you are hearing. The signal flows from Clean through Tone, Dynamics, Voice and Space.

features.title: Clean
features.body: A noise gate, gentle expansion and a room floor remove the air conditioner, the keyboard and the room itself.

features.title: Tone
features.body: A four-point EQ you drag directly on the response graph, plus low cut and high cut for the edges.

features.title: Dynamics
features.body: A visual compressor with draggable knee and ratio handles, make-up lift and an output limiter.

features.title: Bypass anything
features.body: Switch a stage off to hear the difference, or reset it and start again without losing the rest of the chain.

images.label: Clean
images.alt: The Sonus.NET Clean stage with a noise gate curve, room floor and expansion controls
images.caption: Clean. Set the room floor and how far the gate closes before the rest of the chain sees the signal.

images.label: Tone
images.alt: The Sonus.NET Tone stage with a movable frequency response and low and high cut
images.caption: Tone. The curve is the control: drag the points and the frequency response changes with them.

images.label: Dynamics
images.alt: The Sonus.NET Dynamics stage with a compressor curve, make-up lift and output limiter
images.caption: Dynamics. Drag the knee and ratio handles, then watch the live gain reduction as you speak.

detailSections.title:
Change the voice.
Place it in a room.
detailSections.lede: The Voice stage changes who is speaking; the Space stage changes where. Both preview live, and the original microphone signal stays untouched underneath.

features.title: Vocal size
features.body: Formant shifting changes the apparent size of the throat and mouth without moving the pitch.

features.title: Resonance and texture
features.body: Add body, brightness or a little grit until the character sits exactly where you want it.

features.title: A room of its own
features.body: Set a short room and a room mix to put the voice in a believable space instead of a bare studio.

features.title: Controlled echo
features.body: Echo and echo time add distance and drama without turning the take into a wash.

images.label: Voice
images.alt: The Sonus.NET Voice stage with pitch, vocal size, resonance, brightness and texture controls
images.caption: Voice. Pitch and vocal size are separate controls: one moves the note, the other moves the body.

images.label: Space
images.alt: The Sonus.NET Space stage with a room decay curve, room mix and echo time
images.caption: Space. Room and echo have their own visual readout, separate from the voice character.

detailSections.title:
Monitor.
Route. Record.
detailSections.lede: Monitoring, the virtual microphone and the recorder all consume the same processed signal, but they stay independent output paths. Set one up without disturbing the others.

features.title: Headphone monitoring
features.body: Listen on the headphones you chose, at a level that stays separate from what goes to the virtual microphone.

features.title: Test the route
features.body: A short chime confirms the headphone path before you go live, so silence is never a mystery.

features.title: Virtual microphone
features.body: Enable the cable, choose CABLE Output in the other app, and the processed voice arrives there like a real microphone.

features.title: Real files
features.body: Takes are ordinary 48 kHz WAV files in Documents\Sonus Recordings; presets are readable JSON you can copy anywhere.

images.label: Devices
images.alt: The Sonus.NET audio settings with microphone, headphones and virtual microphone routing
images.caption: Settings. Pick the physical input, the headphones for monitoring and the virtual output in one place.

images.label: Takes
images.alt: The Sonus.NET Takes panel with raw and processed recordings and playback transport
images.caption: Takes. Select a recording, then switch between its RAW and PROCESSED versions instantly.

images.label: Presets
images.alt: The Sonus.NET sound library with enhancement and character presets
images.caption: The sound library. Start from a professional sound or a character preset, then make it yours.
